Dasakam 43

#1
Yashodha felt baby Krishna was too heavy to carry and left him on the bed. She was worried of the baby and kept praying to Bhagwan  constantly while attending to her household chores.

#2
Then there heard a terrific sound raising dust all through the atmosphere. Demon Trinavarta came in the form of whirl wind and carried Krishna, the one who carries away the mind of people, amidst the envelope of dust and started rising upward.

#3
The dust caused darkness in the entire Gokulam. Gopas and gopikas lost clear vision and mother Yashoda searched for her baby in that darkness. Not finding Krishna, she cried loudly.

#4
Meanwhile Trinavarta found baby's body becoming more heavier for him to carry and reduced his speed, his body shrank in size and noise of whirling wind also subsided.  Soon the whole Gokulam was echoing the cries of Yashoda.

#5
Nandagopan and other Gopas, Gopikas quickly reached the house and everyone cried in grief. In exhaustion, Trinavartha wanted to release Bhagwan, who actually releases everyone from bondages.

#6
The Gopikas were exhausted by their crying and wailing. Then outside the house, they saw a huge and heavy body falling on the rock. What a wonder! On the chest of the dead body, they found baby Krishna.

#7
Gopas were amazed to see Krishna playing smilingly, with his lotus like hands on the chest of dead body of Trinavartha, without a single bruise. The Gopas picked up Krishna as if they picked up the blue gem from a big mountain.

#8
Nandagopan and Gopas rushed and took the child in arms, embraced and kissed with great joy. Gopikas also wanted to embrace baby Krishna. Krishna, like the honey beetle, jumped in to the lotus like hands of the Gopikas.

#9
Nandagopan and Yashoda wondered how to avoid such incidents in future and hence prayed to Govinda to protect their son, actually they prayed to Bhagwan himself for his own welfare.

#10
Thus Bhagwan killed the Asura who was in the form of the wind. 
Bhattathri requests Bhagwan  to eradicate all his internal and external ailments..txt
